newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's OTP Sec. issues 1-yr FX bond.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's OTP Sec. issues 1-yr FX bond.

text.p: Hungary's OTP Ertekpapir Rt, the securities arm of the OTP financial group, will publicly issue floating rate one-year bearer bonds to invest in futures and forward deals, organisers said on Tuesday.

The issue of "OTP Broker FX 98" bonds follows a similar issue at the end of 1996 by OTP group member OTP Forex Kft which privately placed 500 million forints bonds for six months to invest in high risk instruments, generating an annual yield of 44.07 percent.

"We regarded last year's bond as the herald of the current public bond," said Laszlo Szabo, General Manager of OTP group member of futures brokerage and advisor OTP Forex. "We would like to achieve a performance which matches last year's."
The "OTP Broker FX 98" bond will be issued for domestic clients at par value, its maturity will run from July 25 until July 25, 1998. Subscriptions will run from July 14 to 18.
OTP Ertekpapir will guarantee the repayment of principal, while repayment of principal and payment of interest will come at maturity.

OTP Ertekpapir, which marked investments in this bond as risky because of the nature of forex markets, wants to invest in currency futures deals on the Budapest Commodity Exchange, in forward deals on the interbank market and in BUX index futures on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
OTP Forex Kft is wholly owned by OTP Ertekpapir, which is 100 percent unit of OTP Bank.
